name: Corn wine
summary: Corn wine is distilled by the Thai hosts and poured at the summit-camp supper on the two-day trek.
origin: The summit camp, Pù Luông. Source: VietNamNet, 16 Nov 2025.
howToEat: At the camp supper, beside grilled chicken and steamed sticky rice.
where: The summit camp on the two-day trek.
seoTitle: Corn wine at the Pu Luong summit camp
seoDescription: Rượu ngô is corn wine the Thai hosts distill and pour at the Pù Luông summit-camp supper.
